title: Circuit with fan-out at most two
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, whose gates have distinct arguments, whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument, and whose gates each have at most two arguments. The circuit obtained by iterated fan-out expansion of its gate list has the expanded gate list and the output vertex obtained by applying the expansion's map to the original output.
hypotheses_covered: natural number n and a circuit with n inputs
circuit is well formed: each gate has distinct arguments and each NOT gate has one argument
each gate has at most two arguments
